doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Marriage ends, leaving for New York
summary: He and his wife wanted different things, so he left the family home and went to New York.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Now, was your family in California at this point and you were in Vegas -­

No, the family was there. We had a house and everything, yeah. We were set. Yep. Yep. Yep. We were set and then, like, you know, the -- the differences between husband and wife, you know. You know, we just outgrew -- she wanted to do one thing, I wanted to do another thing. I said, "Well," so I split. You know, went to New York.
